controls: R-GAME-2 keyboard controls only, sent as ordinary browser input by the test browser
pointerSpace: fraction of the canvas size, measured from the canvas centre (x right, y down)
purpose: Driver input for input-latency cells: one short right step and one short left step per 4 s cycle, so the driver stays near its spawn; every keydown is a measured input event.
startAfter: both humans pass the initialCheck and the observed opponent pose is settled (350 ms, as tools/latency)
